content.comment_body: I'm trying to create a User Defined Function (UDF) from a small program consisting of about 15 blocks. However, since the code was copied from a much larger project, the block numbers are over 100, and the UDF feature doesn't allow such high block numbers. Is there an automated way to lower the block numbers, or is manually rewriting everything the only solution?

• Duplicate the original project file. • Remove any unnecessary elements from the project. • Copy and paste the required code as a new instance within the same project. • Adjust or rework as needed. • Build the UDF from the revised project. Let us know if this method helps you.
Thank you very much! This solution works well. The key step is creating the copy within the same project.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces a restriction when creating a User Defined Function due to high block numbers resulting from copying code from a larger project. This technical limitation prevents direct reuse and transfer of code segments, requiring manual adjustment. The community offers a useful workaround that improves workflow and usability despite the product's limitations.
